scope: Two-layer, 1oz FR-4. Rules for repository verification, not an order or fabrication kit.
note: The native phases request 0.15mm tracks; ordinary neck-downs must remain at least 0.10mm. The explicitly requested MCU bypass/return branches remain at least 0.15mm. General track/via clearance uses 0.10mm; component-pad spacing is separately checked at 0.15mm. Vias have a 0.15mm annular ring, so 0.10mm via-edge clearance also gives at least 0.25mm drill-to-copper clearance. PTH annular-ring guidance is distinct from routing-via diameter guidance. Acceptance uses these documented JLCPCB fabrication rules.
open_process_review: J1 exact-import plated slots are shorter than the published 2:1 guidance. See validation/supplier-review.json; JLCPCB confirmation has not been obtained.
